Name: Spin
Overview:
Fly! Warp! Shoot! Pick up stuff! Destroy! Save! Win!

Feel the intense action coursing through your veins as you save the space freighter fleet from maurading pirates!

Spin, a rerelease of a popular shareware shooter of the same name from the 90's, is fun and easy to play, similar to classic arcade games such as Bosconian and Sinistar.
